sources.entry: MenuMeters - CPU, memory, disk, and network monitoring tools for macOS.

summary.one_liner: A fork of the classic MenuMeters macOS menubar utility, updated to run as a standalone app on El Capitan through Big Sur.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes MenuMeters as a menubar monitor for macOS, originally a System Preferences pane. This fork makes a minimal change so it runs as a faceless app that places NSStatusItem items in the menubar instead of NSMenuExtra items, which Apple's SystemUIServer stopped loading for non-Apple-signed extras starting with El Capitan. Since Catalina it is an independent app rather than a preference pane. The README says many community pull requests have been merged. It also points users to newer menubar monitors and to further forks that add features such as DMG installers and CPU meter changes. The README does not list the specific meters beyond the general monitor category.
use_cases: show cpu usage in the macOS menubar
monitor memory, disk, and network in the menubar
run a menubar system monitor on an older macOS version
install a standalone menubar meter app without System Preferences
build MenuMeters from source in Xcode
how_to_run: Download the binary from the location described in the README's installation instructions (the README links are not preserved in the text).
Launch the MenuMeters app; it runs outside System Preferences.
To build from source: clone the git repo.
Build the target MenuMeters to create the independent app.
notable: Runs as a faceless app using NSStatusItem, working around the El Capitan restriction on non-Apple-signed Menu Extras
Originally a System Preferences pane; became a standalone app starting with Catalina
Many community pull requests merged, according to the README
caveats: Targets older macOS releases (El Capitan through Big Sur); the README recommends newer menubar monitors for recent macOS versions
README says it is a minimal modification of the original, and the newer alternatives it links are described as more actively maintained
Installation details are in linked locations not included in the README text
